name: Curvy Plastic Surgery

notes: A Miami clinic with exactly this name exists, so no alternative candidates were needed. Prices may exist in images or on the clinic's Instagram/Facebook/TikTok, which were not checked. No Google rating or review count appears on the fetched pages (a third-party directory in search results showed a rating and a suite number '#412', not used as it is not a permitted source).
